items.t: Engine cradle (subframe) rusting through
items.job: Replace front engine cradle (subframe) and align
items.note: CarComplaints owners report $2,000-3,000 total; a used cradle costs less. Chrysler covered only some vans.

items.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) failure
items.job: Replace and program integrated power module (TIPM)
items.note: Owners report about $1,400-1,600 at dealers.

items.t: Engine stalls while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; repair engine ground or replace EGR valve
items.note: Cost depends on the cause found. CarComplaints lists about $810 as typical.

items.t: Automatic transmission limp mode, slipping or shudder
items.job: Replace solenoid pack or torque converter; replace transmission if worn out
items.note: Owners report $400 for a solenoid and about $1,400 for a torque converter; a full replacement is at the top of this range.

items.t: AWD transfer case (power transfer unit) failure
items.job: Replace AWD power transfer unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,800-3,960.

items.t: Front-end clunks from tie rods, sway bar links and control arm bushings
items.job: Replace worn tie rod ends and sway bar links, then align
items.note: Most owner repairs were under $500; replacing control arms too can push it past $1,000.

items.t: Engine mounts tearing or leaking
items.job: Replace engine mount(s)
items.note: Owners report about $200-550 per visit.

items.t: EGR valve sticking, rough idle and check engine light
items.job: Replace EGR valve
items.note: Owners report about $85-200.

items.t: Radiator cracks and coolant leaks
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant
items.note: Owners report about $450-1,350.

items.t: Fuel supply tube can separate and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel supply tube (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 03V-471.

items.t: Engine computer software can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine computer (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 04V-113.

items.t: Halogen headlights can cut out (recall)
items.job: Repair headlamp circuit (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 05V-066.

items.t: Fuel pump module and engine software can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Update engine software and fuel pump module (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 06V-432.

items.t: Harsh shifting, jerking or slipping from the 9-speed automatic
items.job: Software update and relearn; replace valve body or transmission if needed
items.note: A software update is the cheap end. CarComplaints owners report about $1,300 for hard shifting and about $9,000 for a replacement transmission.

items.t: Oil filter housing and oil cooler leak
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly

items.t: Ticking engine from worn rocker arms
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lash adjusters, both banks
items.note: If a camshaft lobe is worn, the camshaft is added.

items.t: Hybrid battery can catch fire while parked (recall)
items.job: Hybrid battery inspection, software and battery repair (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 24V-538.

items.t: Hybrid battery pack fire risk on 2020-2022 (recall)
items.job: Hybrid battery pack remedy (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 26V-362.

items.t: Hybrid inverter can fail and stop the van (recall)
items.job: Update or replace power inverter module (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 17V-371.

items.t: Gas engine may not restart properly after electric driving (recall)
items.job: Update hybrid control software (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-740.

items.t: 12-volt battery isolator post can overheat (recall)
items.job: Repair 12-volt isolator post (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 20V-334.

items.t: Transmission wiring connector can shut off the engine (hybrid recall)
items.job: Repair hybrid transmission wiring connector (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 23V-010.

items.t: Engine software can lose crank sensor timing and stall (recall)
items.job: Update engine control software (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-049.

items.t: Engine computer power chip can fail and stall the van (recall)
items.job: Replace powertrain control module (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-524.

items.t: Loose battery ground can cut power steering and stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Repair battery ground connection (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 19V-348.

items.t: Cruise control may not turn off (recall)
items.job: Update engine computer software (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-332.

items.t: Badly welded transmission part can cause loss of drive (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair transmission (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-492.

items.t: Right front lower control arm can separate (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace right front lower control arm (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 19V-143.

items.t: Front axle shaft can come apart (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front half-shafts (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 18V-493.

items.t: Side curtain airbag connector may be loose (recall)
items.job: Secure side curtain airbag connector (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 24V-793.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not hold pressure (recall)
items.job: Replace side curtain airbags (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 26V-189.

items.t: Second-row seat latch can stick open (recall)
items.job: Repair second-row seat latch (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 22V-181.

items.t: Steering column module weld can stop the driver airbag (recall)
items.job: Replace steering column control module (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 24V-199.

items.t: Brake pedal sensor can disable stability control (recall)
items.job: Replace brake pedal position sensor (free recall repair)
items.note: Done free by a Chrysler dealer under recall 26V-561.
